description: Need for Speed: Hot Pursuit 2, the PS2 version decompiled and ported natively to Switch, at 720p. Needs your own PS2 disc: the PAL version 1.00 (SLES-50731).

notes: The language is chosen at every start.
config.txt sets frame_limit (30 by default) and show_fps.

inputs.label: The NFSHP2 folder's two data files from your PS2 disc, PAL version 1.00 (SLES-50731) only, about 3.1 GB

options.label: From the disc, or made by the web installer from your ISO

generated.note: Frame limit and FPS counter, made on first start
Your saves and the graphics pipeline cache

steps: Copy ZDIR.BIN and ZZDATA.BIN from the NFSHP2 folder of your PAL 1.00 disc to switch/NFSHP2-Switch/.
Or, on a PC, give your unmodified ISO to the web installer (https://HDErick.github.io/NFSHP2_Switch_Port/); it checks the version and makes a zip for the SD card's root.
